notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.24
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed an issue which was causing objects to fall through the ground.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.23
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.22
notes.notes:
Features:
-Added security alarm to notify players when police have been called or any traps have been triggered.
-Added police cars to warn players that police are coming. Police can chase you. You can run to your truck and escape.
-Added canvases for notifying players that they have been caught and are going to jail.

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue which was breaking players' interaction with anything.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.21
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed an issue which was causing AI to get stuck.
-Fixed an issue which was causing falling through the ground.
-Fixed an issue which was causing CCTV to spawn on clients but not on the host.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.19
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.18
notes.notes:
Features:
-Signal booster adjustments have been made so that player cameras will now require a signal booster after a certain distance.
-Headlamp has been added. The headlamp has a brighter and more steady light than the flashlight.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.16
notes.notes:
Features:
-Added SFX to flashlight.
-Added SFX to clap emote.
-Added SFX to fuse boxes.
-Added SFX to truck door buttons.
-Increased camera spawn chance to %70 used to be %50.
-Increased AI movement speed.
-Increased In-game menu animation speed.
-PC screens are not case sensitive.


Fixes:
-Fixed an issue which was causing players not to lose money after leaving prison.
-Fixed an issue which was causing CCTV cameras not appear.
-Fixed an issue which was causing players to fall through. Now pressing ESC won't make you fall down.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.15
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.14
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Warehouse updated, now has a new look.
-Time no longer passes in the Warehouse.
-Spawn positions in the Warehouse have been updated.
-Button update for the courier has been made.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.13
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed an issue which was causing in-game menu items to slide left.
-Added an indicator for the durability of objects. Full red means items are no longer worth anything.
-Added an indicator for truck door buttons. Green means it's open, red means it's closed.
-Added info for returning to base. If you type 'base' while you are in a house, you go back to your base.
-Changed the burglar customization UI.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.12
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.11
notes.notes:
-Made some improvements to AI. AI now detects lights better.
-Fixed an issue causing doors not to appear in Morgan house.
-Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck in houses.
-Fixed an issue on lobbies which was causing full lobbies to break.
-The AI's sleep duration has been reduced from 300 seconds to 150 seconds.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.10
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed an issue on player ragdolls. Which was causing ragdolls to act weird.
-Fixed an issue which was causing players to fall trough while travelling to houses or warehouse.
-Removed shaders from doors.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.09
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fıxed an issue where player couldn’t return to warehouse.
-Added yellow indicators in warehouse.
-Added more helper text to store.
-Fixed an issue which was causing house info's not to show up.
-Added better pop up message for players when they return from prison.
-Added an indicator on selling truck. Now you can see where to drop stolen objects in your inventory.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.08
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-A light has been added for the player to see the walls in very dark environments.
-The issue with objects increasing in size has been fixed.
-Simultaneous entry while creating a lobby is now prevented.
-Some wrongly spawned items have been fixed.
-The issue where the lobby was not listed after a player left has been fixed.
-The issue where the slot count was not updated after a player left the lobby has been fixed.
-The buttons on the electrical panel in the Warehouse have been fixed.
-Level issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.07
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed font issues on some languages and translation problems.
-Removed some languages we no longer support them.
-Fixed an issue on burglar customization.
-Implemented a help & guide menu for buttons and theirs uses.
-Fixed an issue where late joiners seeing objects stuttering.
-Now you can skip splash screen with any key press.

Known Issues:
-Some objects getting bigger when dropped.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.05
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.04
notes.notes:
Fixes:

-Removed hold indıcator in warehouse. It was causing confusion.
-Added locked indicator for locked doors which you need to break open with a bobby pin.
-Added a bobby pin on table next to flashlight.
-Fixed a bug on burglar customization.
-Fixed a bug which was causing player name tags not to appear.
-Fixed issues on some objects which was causing them not to spawn.
-Balancing on stolen object prices.
-Disabled proximity chat in warehouse. Now you can hear each other anywhere inside of warehouse.
-CCTV is disabled on first day to decrease difficulty.

Known Issues:

-Sometimes when you enter game for the first time character falls under the ground.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.03
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-We have fixed an issue where objects falling through.

Known issues:
-We removed languages which has font issues from supported languages. Still working on fixing them.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.02
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! First of all thank you for trying Burglar Inc. We have been working without having a break since launch. In version 0.1.0.01 of Burglar Inc. we fixed some bugs and implemented a invite friends button.

-Fixed an issue where you can't change your burglars clothing.
-Fixed an issue on Morgan's house entrance door.
-Imlemented a invite friends button which turns on steams friends overlay.
-Fixed an issue that in game settings button doesn't appear.
-Implemented mute function for microphones.

Known Issues:

-Some languages like Chinesse, Russian etc. has font issues and we are working on them.
-Sometimes when you enter game for the first time character falls under the ground.
